task.description: Implement OIDC-F-05: GET /api/tenant-config endpoint. (1) Write migration migrations/NNN_tenant_hostnames.sql: CREATE TABLE tenant_hostnames (id UUID PK default gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL FK tenants(id), hostname TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ default now()). (2) Write src/api/routes/tenant_config.zig: handleTenantConfig(req) queries tenant_hostnames -> oidc_realm_bindings to get realm_name for the given host; if no match, return default realm config. Build OIDC authority URL as env var KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL (default http://localhost:8081) + /realms/ + realm_name. Return JSON { oidc_authority, client_id }. client_id is always bpm-platform-api (no per-tenant client config needed). (3) Register the route in the router as a public route (no auth middleware). (4) zig build + zig build test + zig build migrate must all exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/tenant-config?host=x returns JSON with oidc_authority and client_id
